title: Terminal
insertOnly: Inserted into the command bar; not executed.
inputNotSent: Terminal input was not sent. The connection may have changed.
commandConnected: Command input (Enter sends to the current SSH PTY)
commandLabel: Command input sharing the current SSH PTY
webglDisabled: Terminal graphics acceleration was disabled. The SSH connection is still active.
sshNotConnected: SSH is not connected. Nothing was pasted.
pasteTooLarge: Paste exceeded 1 MB and was blocked.
sessionInactive: The terminal session changed or is inactive. Nothing was pasted.
clipboardReadFailed: Could not read the system clipboard. Use the keyboard paste shortcut.
linkOpened: The link was opened in the system default browser.
linkOpenFailed: Could not open the link. Check your system browser settings.
clipboardWriteFailed: Could not write to the system clipboard.
selectForDiagnosis: Select terminal text to diagnose. The full terminal history will not be read.
noSshForDiagnosis: There is no active SSH session in this terminal.
diagnosePlan: Ask AI for a read-only diagnostic plan…
searchDescription: Searches only the scrollback buffer for the current SSH tab.
multilineDescription: Review multiple lines or control characters before sending them to the current SSH session.
controlWarning: This content includes line breaks or control characters. Canceling or pressing Esc sends no bytes to the server.
externalLinkDescription: Review the full link target. The system default browser opens only after confirmation.
externalLinkWarning: This link came from remote terminal output. Verify that the destination is trusted before opening it in your system browser.
demoContentLabel: Demo terminal content for layout preview only
demoStatic: This is a static UI preview. No SSH connection is active and no command was run.
restoredWorkspaceOnly: Local server tabs and workspace layout were restored. SSH sessions, remote processes, and previous PTYs are not restored.
establishingTerminal: Establishing an interactive SSH terminal after host-key verification.
hostKeyBlocked: A changed host fingerprint blocked the connection. Verify and manage the trusted host record first.
openManagerHint: Open the connection manager to add a profile. The SSH terminal reflects the actual connection state.
